title: SMOK TFOS Replacement Pod - 0.8ohm 2ml
description: Keep your SMOK TFOS pod vape kit performing at its best with these refillable 2ml pods. Each pod features a side-fill port for quick top-ups and an integrated 0.8ohm mesh coil tuned for a smooth draw and clear flavour. They’re ideal for MTL through to a lighter RDL inhale, and pair best with 50/50 freebase or nicotine salt e-liquids. Replace the pod when flavour fades or the coil has worn out. We recommend pairing this pod with 50/50 (freebase) or Nic Salts E-Liquid Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
